item.text: {"summary":"Draft is publishable with minor warnings: it handles the ledger/source discrepancy transparently and keeps units, point, interval, and first-print rule coherent.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"model_prior","severity":"warning","summary":"The model prior is effectively a persistence-plus-three-month momentum rule, but it does not explicitly say whether a broader time-series model was considered or ruled out.","actionRequested":"Add one sentence that either labels the persistence/momentum calculation as the chosen time-series prior or states why no broader model was used."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The interval uses only three recent monthly changes for sigma, which is a very small realized-volatility sample even though it is widened for flash uncertainty.","actionRequested":"Either justify the three-observation volatility sample as intentionally local to the current labour-market regime or add a broader historical volatility anchor if available."}],"optionalSuggestions":["State explicitly that the JSON `resolutionDate` of 2026-07-21 is the expected first-print publication date despite the retained ledger URL discrepancy.","The upside/downside tails are useful; tying them to approximate monthly changes in thousands would make them easier to audit."]}
